messages.author: dc580e17bcfd1819
messages.subject: installation issues w/2.10.0
parts:
I was able to use the previous version of rstan just fine, but after installing v2.10.0, I can no longer get it to work. Trying to build a simple model (rstan::stan_model) in Windows 7, I get an error message:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! g++.exe: error: Files/R/R-3.3.1/library/StanHeaders/libs/x64: No such file or directory

I do see the path:
C:/Program Files/R/R-3.3.1/library/StanHeaders/libs/x64 on my computer,

but not:
Files/R/R-3.3.1/library/StanHeaders/libs/x64

Any suggestions?

Thanks!

-Dan

messages.subject: Re: installation issues w/2.10.0
parts:
On Wednesday, June 29, 2016 at 9:08:13 AM UTC-4, Dalthorp, Daniel wrote:
I was able to use the previous version of rstan just fine, but after installing v2.10.0, I can no longer get it to work. Trying to build a simple model (rstan::stan_model) in Windows 7, I get an error message:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! g++.exe: error: Files/R/R-3.3.1/library/StanHeaders/libs/x64: No such file or directory

For R 3.3.x, you need Rtools33 and to have it configured according to

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started#configuration

Ben
